name: Oren Skyward
exported_coordinate_units: centimeters in independent temporary copies; source metres

textures.Normal: linear tangent; shallow low-frequency scale swatch
textures.ORM: linear R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

source_brief.silhouette: A tall narrow silhouette framed by a short mantle and a large open lantern staff. Two rounded swept horns form an unobtrusive arch above the head.
source_brief.face: Pale moss-gray scales, warm gold eyes and a short rounded muzzle. The face should appear attentive and scholarly rather than ferocious.
source_brief.costume: White traveling robes with deep teal panels, short gold-edged mantle and fitted lower-leg wraps. Split robe panels stop above the ankles.
source_brief.palette: White linen #E5E2D3; teal #3E7F83; moss gray #92A69D; pale gold #C4AC72.
source_brief.equipment: A long staff with an open hexagonal lantern frame and a small sealed map case. No books float as independent actors.
source_brief.signature: Hexagonal lantern head, rounded swept horns and teal vertical robe panels.
source_brief.materials: Matte cloth, subtle scale normal, brushed gold and frosted opaque lantern panels. Keep glowing area small.
source_brief.back: A single wide teal panel and short mantle define the rear. Horns clear the staff during over-shoulder poses.
source_brief.animation: Idle rests the staff near the body. Basics release a small light mote. The active turns the lantern toward the selected ally and lifts the free palm, producing a visibly directed ward.
source_brief.vfx: A pale-gold line leads briefly to the recipient, then a hexagonal shield outline appears. It is protection, not healing or revival.
source_brief.audio: A restrained bell with a short sustaining tail cut on expiry; avoid one continuous sound per shielded target.
source_brief.risk: The selected ally may already carry a stronger shield. Candidate validation and replacement rules must prevent wasted weak overwrites.

equipment: Visual only; Open hexagonal lantern staff in right hand, free left palm, closed rectangular map case; ankle-clearing white/teal split robe. No floating book.
open_reviews: muzzle crest armor and weapon clearance
